guard: screen-based startup choices finish once and disarm their startup deadlines

mutations.name: leave the seat timeout armed after final confirmation
mutations.expectRed: pty-normal: final confirmation disarms the deadline
mutations.cell: pty-normal: final confirmation disarms the deadline

mutations.name: keep pane polling after final confirmation
mutations.expectRed: tmux-normal: final confirmation disarms the deadline
mutations.cell: tmux-normal: final confirmation disarms the deadline

mutations.name: replay terminal capability queries from the captured ready screen
mutations.expectRed: startup fixture log stays within 64KiB (no terminal reply loop)
mutations.cell: startup fixture log stays within 64KiB (no terminal reply loop)
mutations.note: Real tmux replies must not feed a raw capture back into itself. The unchanged bounded reader fails before parsing a runaway log, without a model request or global OOM.

mutations.name: the seat gate ends its watch at the prompt's Enter, before the notice
mutations.find: if (final && this.#notice !== undefined) { this.#awaitingNotice = true; return { key: "Enter", done: false }; }
mutations.expectRed: pty-silent: an answered prompt without its notice fails bounded
mutations.cell: pty-silent: an answered prompt without its notice fails bounded

mutations.name: the core watch ends its watch at the prompt's Enter, before the notice
mutations.find: if (final && this.#notice !== undefined) { this.#awaitingNotice = true; return { key: "Enter", done: false }; }
mutations.expectRed: tmux-silent: an answered prompt without its notice fails bounded
mutations.cell: tmux-silent: an answered prompt without its notice fails bounded

mutations.name: the pty handle reports no outcome
the tmux handle reports the confirmed outcome for a watch that ended ready
